proof.native_title: Probing the Origins of 1,800 MHz Radio Frequency Electromagnetic Radiation Induced Damage in Mouse Immortalized Germ Cells and Spermatozoa in vitro

candidate_claims.text: The experiment found stage-, time- and assay-dependent responses. Mature sperm showed selected later motility and oxidative-DNA findings, while fragmentation results differed by assay and exposure interval.
candidate_claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 8 to 9 and 13 to 14, Results, Figures and Discussion

candidate_claims.text: Mitochondrial probe signals and selected sperm assays do not establish a complete causal disease pathway or human infertility. The experiment studied isolated cells and sperm rather than conception or offspring outcomes.

proof.native_title: RF-EMF Exposure near 5G NR Small Cells

candidate_claims.text: The measured base stations did not themselves meet the paper's small-cell power definitions. Measurements were rescaled to selected small-cell settings, and typical-user and non-user scenarios were calculated rather than directly sampled as population exposure.
candidate_claims.locator: Main PDF physical page 6, site definitions; pages 10 to 12, scenario interpretation and Discussion

candidate_claims.text: The reported rescaled scenarios were below the reference levels used under the stated assumptions. Antenna geometry, traffic, close-distance gaps and unresolved maximum-label wording limit numerical reuse; no health outcomes were measured.
candidate_claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 9 to 12, Figures, Table and Discussion

proof.native_title: Exposure to 26.5 GHz, 5G modulated and unmodulated signal, does not affect key cellular endpoints of human neuroblastoma cells

candidate_claims.text: Neither tested signal significantly changed the measured cell-cycle distribution or comet-assay damage relative to sham. Prior RF exposure also did not significantly alter the damage response to the later menadione challenge.
candidate_claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 6 to 9, Results and Figures

candidate_claims.text: A delayed chemical challenge in a transformed cell line does not represent every combined exposure or human tissue dose. Nonsignificant comparisons under this protocol do not establish universal equivalence or absence of clinical harm.
candidate_claims.locator: Main PDF physical pages 3 to 6, experimental sequence; pages 9 to 10, Discussion and Conclusion

candidate_claims.text: Trolox attenuation was selective rather than uniform across the sperm and molecular assays. Mitochondrial measures were not rescued, and a higher concentration was not uniformly more favorable.

proof.native_title: Link between Wi-Fi, cordless devices, mobile phone usage patterns, and behavioral problems among Japanese children: A prospective cohort study.

candidate_claims.text: The report found sporadic behavioral-screening associations in both directions. Some comparisons survived false-discovery correction while other nominal findings did not; the pattern does not establish RF harm or benefit.
